rfam.comment: This entry contains a glucosamine-6-phosphate activated ribozyme that is found in the mRNA for GlmS. GlmS is an enzyme that uses fructose-6-phosphate and glutamine to generate glucosamine-6-phosphate. The ribozyme catalyses self cleavage of the glmS mRNA that is thought to regulate GlmS activity [1].

curation.author: Winkler WC, Nahvi A, Roth A, Collins JA, Barrick JE, Breaker RR
